user.title: Configure CozyLife
user.description:
Click Submit to begin scanning your network for connected devices.

Home Assistant will probe each detected subnet within the default range 192.168.0.0 - 192.168.0.255 using TCP port 5555.

Tick the box to specify a custom IP range instead.

select_many.title: Select CozyLife Devices
select_many.description: Choose the discovered CozyLife devices that you would like to add to Home Assistant. You can select more than one device before continuing.

init.title: Update CozyLife device
init.description:
Adjust the stored connection details or update the friendly name and area.

DIY mappings are optional and user-defined. They stay outside the repository's supported device surface.

Catalog DPIDs for this device: {available_dpids}.
Observed live DPIDs that also match the catalog: {observed_dpids}.
Observed boolean-like DPIDs that can be used for custom writable switches: {writable_dpids}.

Read mappings create custom sensor entities. Format them as `7=Contact Raw, 10=Leak Alarm`.
Writable mappings require a per-device opt-in and currently support only boolean switches. Format them as `7=switch:bool:Contact Relay`.
